channel.title: WaveSurvivor Updates
channel.description: Official WaveSurvivor patch notes from Haider Games

item.title: v0.1.67 — Chapter 1 Mission Map
item.description: Offline Story now opens a connected Chapter 1 mission route directly, with automatic campaign saving behind the scenes.

item.title: v0.1.66 — Chapter 1 Mission Progression Framework
item.description: Offline Story now has the Chapter 1 progression foundation for six ordered missions while the current combat remains available as a legacy flow.

item.title: v0.1.65 — Base Critical Damage Balance
item.description: Player Critical Damage now starts at 1.0× instead of 2.0×; existing Critical Damage upgrades still add to that base.

item.title: v0.1.64 — Tighter DPS Multi-Projectile Crosshair
item.description: The DPS primary-fire crosshair is more compact with two or three projectiles, while actual projectile spread stays the same.

item.title: v0.1.63 — Boss Transition No Longer Waits for Cards
item.description: Offline Story now starts the Boss intro after Core 3 without waiting for pending card choices; the offers remain available.

item.title: v0.1.62 — Total Kills Achievement Rebalance
item.description: Rare Total Kills now requires 10,000 account kills and Epic requires 50,000; completed tiers continue showing live numerical progress.

item.title: v0.1.61 — 70-Kill Offline Core Defense
item.description: Each Offline Story Core Defense now completes at 70 legitimate kills instead of 80, with the HUD and resumed progress using the same target.

item.title: v0.1.60 — Faster Damage Popups
item.description: Damage numbers now complete their existing movement and fade animation 25% faster than the previous popup speed.

item.title: v0.1.59 — Responsive FPS Movement
item.description: Ground and air movement now respond quickly to current WASD input while keeping smooth jump momentum and a clear movement-speed limit.

item.title: v0.1.58 — Boss1 Airborne Damage Fix
item.description: Boss1 now ignores player damage while airborne during its Phase 1 jumps and Phase 2 tracking dive, preventing midair defeats.

item.title: v0.1.57 — Shorter Offline Core Defenses
item.description: Offline Story Core defenses now require 80 legitimate enemy kills each, down from 100, with the same rewards and refill pacing.

item.title: v0.1.56 — Core Travel Timer and Minimap
item.description: Offline Story Core travel now starts at 60 seconds, shortens to three seconds near the selected Core, and keeps the broad minimap until Core Defense begins.

item.title: v0.1.55 — Boss1 Phase 1 Attack Clarity
item.description: Boss1's Phase 1 warning cone clears as the directional ground wave launches, and the landing now carries the existing impact camera shake.

item.title: v0.1.54 — Core Defense Target Display Fix
item.description: Offline Story Core Defense now keeps its configured 100-kill target on the HUD from the start, including after resuming a run.

item.title: v0.1.53 — Three Core Encounters Before Boss
item.description: Offline Story now uses three unique Core regions before the existing Boss encounter, preserving the selected route and placement when a run resumes.

item.title: v0.1.52 — Kill-Only DPS Passive
item.description: DPS Progressive Fire now builds Attack Speed only from legitimate enemy kills; the existing 20-second grace and one-stack-per-second decay remain.

item.title: v0.1.51 — Final Explore Batch Completion Fix
item.description: Offline Story's final Red Explore batch now completes only after all issued Red enemies are defeated; the first five section handoffs keep their existing pacing.

item.title: v0.1.50 — Enemy Tracker Projectile Guidance
item.description: DPS Enemy Tracker shots keep their initial aim, then bend toward enemies once they become visible from the projectile's position.

item.title: v0.1.49 — Boss1 Phase 1 Ground Wave Fix
item.description: Boss1's Phase 1 attack now resolves the authored city roads after landing and emits its aimed directional ground wave.

item.title: v0.1.48 — Core Defense Minimap Framing
item.description: Offline Story Core Defense minimaps now frame the selected Core and its full authored enemy spawn area, with steady, aspect-correct coverage.

item.title: v0.1.47 — Faster Floating Damage Numbers
item.description: Floating damage numbers keep their current animation and play through it 10% faster.

item.title: v0.1.46 — Hound Targeting Fix
item.description: Enemy Tracker now follows the Hound's animated body center, making visible-body aiming work reliably from every direction.

item.title: v0.1.45 — Tighter DPS Primary-Fire Spread
item.description: DPS primary-fire projectiles now spread less, with matching aim indicators for every shot.

item.title: v0.1.44 — Offline Story Explore Pacing
item.description: Offline Story's opening Explore advances through six authored 10-enemy batches when two or fewer enemies from the current batch remain. The HUD now shows only EXPLORE.

item.title: v0.1.40 — Offline Story Core Defense Population
item.description: Offline Story Core defenses now run to 100 legitimate kills and refill more quickly as active enemies fall, while keeping the 10-enemy cap.

item.title: v0.1.39 — Offline Story Explore Route and Core Travel
item.description: The opening Explore follows six authored regions, Core travel uses walkable path distance, and the current Core and player-start placements are synchronized.

item.title: v0.1.38 — Offline Story Core Travel and Spawn Fixes
item.description: Core travel now preserves DPS passive timing, defense enemies follow the selected Core's spawn region, and Archive Cores appear at their intended size and placement.

item.title: v0.1.37 — Offline Story Spawn Regions
item.description: Offline Story enemies and Healer Hearts now use the authored spawn areas for each Core location, with improved Boss arena add placement.

item.title: v0.1.36 — Playtest Mode Access
item.description: Story Offline remains playable while Online and Endless are clearly marked under construction in the menu.

item.title: Update v0.1.35
item.description: DISCORD: Rich Presence now shows your current mode, role, Story objective or Endless wave, and online party size.

item.title: Update v0.1.34
item.description: STORY: Fixed Explore kill credit so legitimate enemy defeats advance reliably and the 20th defeat starts the Core route.

item.title: Update v0.1.33
item.description: STORY: Added a randomized four-region Core route with 50-enemy defenses, escalating card rewards, and regional enemy spawning.

item.title: Update v0.1.31
item.description: BOSS: Grounded Boss1's landing and shockwave warnings, set a three-second locked escape window, and made the landing circle lethal.

item.title: Update v0.1.30
item.description: DPS: Passive stacks now have a 15-second grace period, then decay one per second; Save & Exit preserves the exact decay timing.

item.title: Update v0.1.29
item.description: STORY: Defeat and victory now clear finished run saves; Core Defense advances to Boss at 80 kills, with a clearer objective handoff and preserved DPS passive state on Save & Exit.

item.title: Update v0.1.28
item.description: STORY HUD: Raised the Travel and Core Defense phase titles above their progress bars for clearer reading.

item.title: Update v0.1.27
item.description: ACHIEVEMENTS: Total Kills now grants a persistent percentage Combat Power bonus to player damage and healing at Common, Uncommon, Rare, and Epic tiers.

item.title: Update v0.1.26
item.description: ACHIEVEMENTS: Added persistent Total Kills progression with Common, Uncommon, Rare, and Epic tiers and an account reward.

item.title: Update v0.1.25
item.description: BOSS: Overhauled Boss1 combat with a new below-50% airborne targeting slam, clearer landing and shockwave warnings, and 5000 HP.

item.title: Update v0.1.24
item.description: STORY: Clarified travel and defense progress text, and quickened late-defense enemy pacing.

item.title: Update v0.1.23
item.description: STORY: Added a clear travel countdown and Core-defense progress bar, smoother defense spawns, and card offers at defeat milestones.

item.title: Update v0.1.22
item.description: STORY: The test encounter now moves from 20 Explore defeats through a 25-second Core travel period and 80 Core-defense defeats to the boss.

item.title: Update v0.1.21
item.description: HUD: The minimap now zooms into local defense near an active Core, with clearer markers and Core direction guidance.

item.title: Update v0.1.20

item.title: Update v0.1.17
item.description: GAMEPLAY: Added authored combat-region spawning for Archive Core encounters.

item.title: Update v0.1.16
item.description: HUD: Reworked progression around objectives instead of numbered waves.

item.title: Update v0.1.15
item.description: OBJECTIVES: Archive Core activation is now much easier to notice.

item.title: Update v0.1.14
item.description: GAMEPLAY: Enemies now disappear immediately when defeated.

item.title: Update v0.1.13
